derivation: Per-source entity floors for the deploy.yml 'Verify harmonized output'
gate. Regenerated 2026-08-19 from one full 15-source harvest on
ammitto/ammitto main 5e8b95c — the exact SHA deploy.yml pins, with NO
branches applied and a clean working tree — over the fifteen data-*
clones whose HEAD SHAs are recorded in data_repo_commits. Each source
was harmonized ALONE first so no failure could mask another, then one
combined run produced the artifact tree the gate actually reads.
WHY THIS REVISION EXISTS: un_vessels stopped being pending.
data-un-vessels#5 removed processed/ from that repository .gitignore,
and its 06:21Z fetch on 2026-08-19 committed 60 vessel YAML files at
ce9f38f4. The pending gate then did exactly what it was built to do and
failed the build - "Pending source un_vessels harmonized 59 entities:
its input is back" - which is what forces a recalibration rather than a
quiet floor bump. un_vessels moves to publishing_sources here, with a
measured floor, and leaves the harmonize step --allow-empty list in the
same change: a source gated on a floor must not also be exempt from the
producer own gates, or a future outage is excused twice. That is how un
and ca left the list on 2026-08-07.
ru stays pending: data-ru still ships no processed YAML, harmonize
still reports 'No YAML files found', and its solo run still exits 1
alone and 0 under --allow-empty. Its provisional floor is carried
forward untouched because its input is unchanged.
Two derivation classes:
1. measured (the 14 publishing sources): floor(count * 70 / 100) in
INTEGER arithmetic - binary floating point makes floor(1370 * 0.70)
evaluate to 958 in jq 1.6 while the exact value is 959, so
regenerate with integers or the floors drift by one. count is the
source's entities value in the COMBINED run's stats.json, because
that is the exact number the verify gate compares against the floor.
Every solo graph dedups to exactly its combined value (all 14 match
this harvest), so no dedup crosses sources and the counts do not
depend on the source order of the harmonize command. Three sources
transform more records than their graphs keep: ca 5690 -> 5582,
cn 323 -> 322, jp 7980 -> 5097 (announcement ingestion emits
heavily duplicated records within jp itself); the other eleven are
duplicate-free.
2. provisional (ru): harvests exactly 0. A floor of 0 would disable the
gate, so the placeholder is carried forward and is never compared
while the source is pending - the pending gate holds it at exactly
zero instead.
total_entities_floor = floor(61045 * 70 / 100) = 42731, where 61045 is
the combined run's total_entities - equal to both the sum of the 14
per-source combined counts and the deduplicated search-index row count
of the same run.
measured_entity_counts is documentation only; the workflow reads
source_floors and total_entities_floor.
Regenerate this ENTIRE file from the next reviewed full 15-source

partition: publishing_sources and pending_sources partition source_floors: every
key appears in exactly one list. publishing_sources are harmonized and
gated on their floors below. pending_sources are named in the harmonize
step's --allow-empty list because their input is missing or empty
upstream; the verify step holds each at EXACTLY zero entities and no
published aggregate, so the day one of them harvests real data the gate
fails and forces its floor to be recalibrated before it is published.
That is deliberately the opposite of relaxing the floor to 0: a floor
of 0 would accept both zero and a half-restored source, this accepts
only zero. That mechanism is exactly why this revision exists - see
